Subject: SOC2 evidence handoff — need to nudge timing

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the initial intake last week. We need to compress our EU-facing SOC2 evidence handoff and align the pen-test kickoff given an internal holiday block that landed on our security team's calendar. I wanted to check whether we can move the session currently scheduled for Jan 21 to one of the windows below (60-minute compressed brief + Q&A, prefer CET-friendly times):

Option A — Jan 19, 10:00–11:00 CET (09:00–10:00 UTC)
Option B — Jan 20, 14:00–15:00 CET (13:00–14:00 UTC)
Option C — Jan 22, 08:00–09:00 CET (07:00–08:00 UTC)

We also want the pen-test vendor to hear the brief so they can confirm scope during kickoff. I'll ideally have our security ops (security@clearcard.com) on the call.

Attached: a short evidence map and our DPA questions that we'd like covered in the briefing.

Could you let me know which window works? If none, please propose two alternatives between Jan 18–24 and I'll get right back to you.

Best,
Elaine Holt
Director, InfoSec Programs
ClearCard

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-map-v2.pdf (5 pages, PDF), DPA_Questions-fillable.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Hi Elaine,

Thanks for the heads up — we can accommodate a compressed 60-minute brief. Quick notes:

- Option B (Jan 20, 14:00–15:00 CET) looks clean on our side and keeps most engineering owners awake.
- If you need earlier coverage (Option A), we can do that too but would need Camila to run the ops bridge and Laura to keep the evidence runbook concise.
- We'll include a short 10-minute pen-test scope segment at the end so pentestops can confirm kickoff details.

For logistics I'll create a calendar invite once we confirm. Linking the HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5532 — if the pen-test vendor needs pre-reads, we'll push the trimmed evidence map ahead of the call.

Can you confirm Option B? If so I'll send the invite and loop the vendor in.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Head of Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference
